success.description: `true` when the document is deleted: either a 2xx response, or a `590` followed by a confirmed absence from the documents list. On failure the action fails and returns nothing

status_code.description: HTTP status code returned by the `DELETE` (`204`, `200`, or `590` when the deletion was confirmed by listing)

verified_by_listing.description: `true` when the API returned `590` and the deletion was confirmed by re-listing the documents; `false` for a plain 2xx

api_error.description: Only when `verified_by_listing` is `true`: the `error`/`message` of the `590` body (e.g. `Document was not found on the server.`), kept for troubleshooting

message.description: Human-readable outcome, e.g. `Document deleted` or `Document deleted (confirmed by listing; the API returned 590: Document was not found on the server.)`
